text:
Green vegetable bug / green stink bug (Nezara viridula), rated as a high-importance pest.

Description: a shield-shaped green bug, roughly 15 mm long, with a distinctive smell when disturbed; feeds by piercing and sucking plant sap. It attacks many host crops, not just corn. Adults are winged and can move readily between fields; nymphs pass through several colour-changing stages before reaching the adult form.

Damage: feeding by piercing developing kernels and pods causes shrivelled, deformed, or discoloured grain, and can reduce seed quality and germination when feeding occurs on developing seed.
